summary: Correction to evidence-signing-pull-requests: the operator step and the key-exposure caveat are manual items, not none

replay.detail: No graph, claim or storage change.

rules.detail: No checkpoint rule change. A pull-request run now refuses when either run-actor variable is unset or unlisted.

compatibility.detail: No client, wire or harness contract change; a refusal only means no note is made.

manual.detail: Operations must let the evidence-signing environment accept pull_request refs (refs/pull/*/merge) and must not add reviewers or a wait timer. Anyone with write access to this repository can read the signing key through their own pull request's workflow file; the author list narrows who gets a note, not who can read the key. Recorded as known defect 20.

recovery.detail: Narrow the evidence-signing environment to the merge queue and main, or revert; notes already signed stay valid only through the base-commit key list.
